lines: # aiforcompanies.co.uk. What runs it, and why each one.
## Site
Next.js on AWS Amplify. One repo, the site at the root.
No monorepo config, so Amplify finds it and builds it.
## Form
Two steps. First name and work email, then company and team.
Consent box unticked. The download never depends on it.
## Email
Resend. Free to 3,000 a month. One file names the vendor.
- not SES: sandbox exit, raw MIME, bounce plumbing, same price
- not the CRM's email: one follow-up per form, on a paid seat
## CRM
HubSpot, free tier. Both form steps post to one contact:
created on step one, updated on step two.
## Booking
cal.com. One link, one constant, used site-wide.
## Two things that bit
- Amplify env vars reach the build, not the server runtime.
Anything read per request is written to .env.production
by one line in amplify.yml. Secrets arrive as one JSON blob.
- A form id that was set nowhere. Every live submit would
have failed. Now a fallback id, so a missing variable
cannot take the page down.
